heroBody: Turn your notes into a study set in under a minute. Then let flashcards, adaptive practice and spaced repetition do what they do best: make it stick.
trust: Free for the essentials. No ads from third parties.
modesTitle: Six ways to study one set
modesBody: Make a set once and switch between modes as you get stronger.
modeFlashcardsBody: Flip, swipe and sort cards into what you know and what needs work.
modeLearnBody: Adaptive questions that bring back what you miss until you get it right.
modeTestBody: Build a practice test with the question types you choose, then review your mistakes.
modeMatchBody: Race the clock to pair terms with definitions and beat your best time.
modeReviewBody: A daily queue that shows each card just before you'd forget it.
modeListenBody: Hear terms and definitions read aloud, hands-free.
how1Body: Paste from a spreadsheet, import a CSV, or let AI draft cards from your notes for you to edit.
how2Body: Every card moves through four stages, from new to mastered, as you answer it.
how3Body: Short daily reviews, scheduled for you, keep knowledge fresh for the long term.
mosaicBody: Each card is a tile. As you learn, the mosaic for your set fills with colour, so you always know where you stand.
teachersBody: Create a class, share a join code, assign sets and see how everyone is progressing.
pricingFreeBody: Unlimited sets, every study mode, and a monthly allowance of AI help.
pricingPremiumBody: More AI, images and audio on cards, offline downloads and deeper analytics.
finalTitle: Your first set is a minute away
sampleDefinition: The organelle that produces most of a cell's energy (ATP)
